The Free Land of Western View is a huge, genial nation, renowned for its state-planned economy, frequent executions, and punitive income tax rates. The compassionate population of 549 million Wesserns are fiercely patriotic and enjoy great social equality; they tend to view other, more capitalist countries as somewhat immoral and corrupt.

The large, socially-minded government juggles the competing demands of Welfare, Education, and Social Policy. It meets to discuss matters of state in the capital city of Wessernia. The average income tax rate is 61.2%, and even higher for the wealthy.

The Wessernian economy, worth 39.2 trillion Westerns a year, is driven entirely by a combination of government and state-owned industry, with private enterprise illegal. The industrial sector, which is broadly diversified, is led by the Book Publishing industry, with major contributions from Tourism, Cheese Exports, and Furniture Restoration. Average income is 71,446 Westerns, and distributed extremely evenly, with practically no difference between the richest and poorest citizens.

Inter-species marriages are ignored by the government, the country is governed by a clique of political insiders known colloquially as The Establishment, Leader spends weekends doing the laundry of foreign leaders, and attendance of fathers at PTA meetings is at an all-time high. Crime, especially youth-related, is totally unknown, thanks to a capable police force and progressive social policies in education and welfare. Western View's national animal is the Dolphin, which frolics freely in the nation's sparkling oceans.

Western View is ranked 159,181st in the world and 228th in Cordone for Largest Arms Manufacturing Sector, scoring 3,258.5 on the Charon Conveyancy Index.

The Megacorporation of WMW Company is a huge, safe nation, ruled by Maximilian Wolff with a fair hand, and remarkable for its barren, inhospitable landscape, state-planned economy, and absence of drug laws. The democratic population of 817 million Sestericstans enjoy a sensible mix of personal and economic freedoms, while the political process is open and the people's right to vote held sacrosanct.

The medium-sized government juggles the competing demands of Welfare, Education, and Healthcare. It meets to discuss matters of state in the capital city of Headquarters in Camphill. The average income tax rate is 40.4%, but much higher for the wealthy.

The sizeable but inefficient WMW Companyian economy, worth 37.7 trillion Sestercians a year, is driven entirely by a combination of government and state-owned industry, with private enterprise illegal. However, for those in the know, there is a slick, highly efficient, broadly diversified black market in Cheese Exports, Woodchip Exports, Soda Sales, and Retail. The private sector mostly consists of enterprising ten-year-olds selling lemonade on the sidewalk, but the government is looking at stamping this out. Average income is 46,106 Sestercians, and evenly distributed, with the richest citizens earning only 2.8 times as much as the poorest.

WMW Company has designated Headquarters in Camphill as its capital city, homophobia is off the menu, street crime is on the rise as police officers spend most of their time in prisons, and Maximilian Wolff has just been declared ruler of WMW Company in an international press conference. Crime is totally unknown, thanks to a capable police force and progressive social policies in education and welfare. WMW Company's national animal is the Black Labrador, which teeters on the brink of extinction due to widespread deforestation.

WMW Company is ranked 197,006th in the world and 329th in Cordone for Largest Arms Manufacturing Sector, scoring 1,897.27 on the Charon Conveyancy Index.
